title: Diagnostics
description: A device's answer to GET /v1/diagnostics, on the port it gives for rest. The Diagnostics-Checksum header carries the checksum of exactly these bytes, in hex, in the algorithm from its health answer. A device may send fields this schema does not know, and the checksum covers them too.

status.description: The device's status in its own words, kept as sent and never interpreted (Q-05).
